title: README gate-mapping table abbreviates 4 of 9 workflow step names instead of matching them 1:1
evidence:
README.md rows (read from worktree):
| Core unit tests (determinism + topology) | `odin test core` |
| Golden harness (T1 + T2 + replay gate) | `tools/harness.sh run` |
| Assist preview cross-check (R2a preview == sim) | `tools/harness.sh preview-check` |
| Stats stream replay-identity | `tools/harness.sh stats-check pause` + `qos_contention` |
vs .github/workflows/ci.yml step names (read from worktree):
- name: Core unit tests (the determinism + topology contracts)
- name: Golden harness (T1 hashes + T2 software pixels + replay gate)
- name: Assist preview cross-check (R2a preview == sim routing)
- name: Stats stream replay-identity (live == replay)
detail: The lens-guard requires the README table to match workflow steps 1:1 in names AND order. Order and local-stage commands are correct, and ci-local.sh's GATES array quotes the names verbatim, but 4 of the 9 README table rows paraphrase the step names.
recommended_fix: Quote the ci.yml step names verbatim in the table's left column (e.g. 'Core unit tests (the determinism + topology contracts)', 'Golden harness (T1 hashes + T2 software pixels + replay gate)', 'Assist preview cross-check (R2a preview == sim routing)', 'Stats stream replay-identity (live == replay)').
